name: 21028 · Churchville, MD
findings: ZIP 21028 (Churchville) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21028 (Churchville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 21028 (Churchville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
